messages.subject: shiny-server.conf confusion
parts:
Is it required that the name of the locations in the shiny-server.conf file be "ShinyApps" and "myApp" for site_dir and app_dir respectively? The documentation does not specify this, it only uses them as examples. What if I wanted to host a single shiny app with the location set to ShinyApps using "site_dir" and host an entire directory with the location set to specialApp using "app_dir"? 

Do "ShinyApps" and "specialApp" or "myApp" have specific system attributes that have to be used in the context the Shiny Server Pro guide instructs? Or could I conceivable name a directory "EltonJohn" to be the directory that contains my ui.R, server.R and data directory for my single shiny application?

Having a hard time wrapping my head around this part. Any clarification from anyone would be appreciated.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny-server.conf confusion
parts: The locations are totally arbitrary, sorry if that is not clear. Although for your example, I think "SirEltonJohn" would be more correct. ;)
